Committee: Ways and Means Education
Sponsor: Grimsley
Analyst: JT Mathis
Date: 03/14/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 465 as introduced would exempt the Alabama State Missionary Baptist Convention and its members that are in good standing from all state, county, and municipal fees and taxes which would decrease receipts to the Education Trust Fund, State General Fund, Public School Fund, Soldiers Fund, and county and municipal funds and other funds into which local fees and taxes are deposited by an undetermined amount dependent upon the amount of taxes and fees that would otherwise be collected.
In addition, this bill requires the Convention to provide an annual report of its members in good standing to the Department of Revenue.
Danny Garrett, Chair
Ways and Means Education

Committee: Ways and Means Education
Sponsor: Grimsley
Analyst: JT Mathis
Date: 03/16/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 465 as substituted and reported by the Committee on Ways and Means Education would exempt the Alabama State Missionary Baptist Convention and its members that are in good standing from all state, county, and municipal sales and use taxes which would decrease receipts to the Education Trust Fund, county, and municipal funds by an undetermined amount dependent upon the amount of taxes that would otherwise be collected.
In addition, this bill requires the Convention to provide an annual report of its members in good standing to the Department of Revenue.
Danny Garrett, Chair
Ways and Means Education
